subject: Aurora Supply onboarding: reissue PO number, spend cap oversubscription, and line-code correction
messages:
From: Alex Mendez <alex.mendez@aurorasupply.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurorasupply.com
Date: 2026-12-10T09:12:21-08:00
Subject: Aurora Supply onboarding: provisional PO number mismatch

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Our procurement team received the provisional purchase order from Redwood but the PO number we were given is "TMP-67891" and does not match the format your accounting team indicated (PO-YYYY-XXXXX). Our AP system rejects TMP- prefixes and we've hit a hard stop on the initial 3 line items for the pilot shipment.

Two immediate asks: can you reissue a canonical PO number to match Redwood's template, and confirm the spend cap associated with this vendor for the pilot? The invoice we tried to submit shows a spend cap of $5,000 in the header but the signed quote was for $45,000.

Attached: PO export and vendor onboarding sheet (PDF).

Appreciate a tight turnaround — our fulfillment window is next week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Mendez
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Supply
attachment: Aurora_PO_export.pdf (pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mendez <alex.mendez@aurorasupply.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-10T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Supply onboarding: provisional PO number mismatch

Hi Alex — thanks for flagging. Sorry for the friction here. I'm looping in Ben (procurement ops) and Laura (finance) and Connor (vendor enablement) so we can triage.

Preliminary notes:
- We should not be shipping with TMP- PO prefixes; that looks like a provisional token generated by our onboarding flow.
- The spend cap discrepancy is likely due to an incorrectly populated field in the onboarding form (vendor_onboard_form.pdf attached).
- Line item #3 SKU (AS-300-B) is coming through with an internal code that doesn't map to Aurora's SKU; we'll need a line-code correction and a short PO amendment to avoid a goods mismatch at receiving.

Next steps proposed: Ben/Laura to confirm whether we can reissue the canonical PO (PO-2026-67891) and increase the spend cap to $50,000 for the pilot period; Connor to adjust the SKU mapping and produce an updated PO XLS for Aurora to quick-accept. If we need a DocuSign amendment I'll draft it and route to Alex.

Alex — can you confirm acceptance of a reissued PO and a DocuSign amendment? If yes, we'll aim to have paperwork out by end of day tomorrow (12/11).

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
attachment: vendor_onboard_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T08:15:45-08:00
Subject: RE: Aurora Supply onboarding: provisional PO number mismatch — ops findings (PROC-934)

Mina / team — investigated the issuance logs and here's what I found (Jira PROC-934 created):
- Source: onboarding service generated a provisional token (TMP-67891) because vendor profile hit an autosave race; canonical issuance hook didn't fire.
- Impact: PO token not stamped into primary PO table; downstream spend cap defaulted to $5,000 (system fallback).
- Line item mismap: CSV to ledger transform swapped the external SKU for internal product_code on row 3; that needs a manual remap to Aurora's AS-300-B.

Options:
1) Reissue canonical PO-2026-67891 and update spend cap to $50,000 (requires finance approval and accounting remap) — ETA 2 business days to propagate into AP.
2) Temporary override: issue a short-term supplemental PO (SUP-67891) for the $40k remainder so Aurora can ship this week while we correct the canonical record — ETA immediate but requires manual reconciliation later.

Recommendation: go with option 1 unless Aurora requires immediate shipment. If we choose option 2 we must ticket accounting for reconciliation and add a note to avoid double-billing. I'm attaching an updated PO spreadsheet (PO_67891_lineitems.xlsx) with corrected SKU mapping for review.

Ben
Ben Carter
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
attachment: PO_67891_lineitems.xlsx (xlsx)
reference: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-934

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Alex Mendez <alex.mendez@aurorasupply.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Supply onboarding: provisional PO number mismatch — decision and next steps

Thanks Ben — good triage. Alex — quick decision from our side after reviewing options:

- We will reissue the canonical PO as PO-2026-67891 and increase the spend cap to $50,000 for the pilot.
- Connor will publish a corrected PO spreadsheet and a short amendment to the original quote; I'll route a DocuSign for Aurora to sign (link included below).
- To reduce ops churn, we will NOT create a supplemental PO — accounting will accept the canonical replacement but needs the signed amendment for audit.

Timeline:
- 12/11 EOD: corrected PO spreadsheet uploaded and DocuSign envelope created.
- 12/12 10:00 PST: expected vendor signature and confirmation.
- 12/13: AP will ingest the corrected PO into the ledger (Laura to confirm ingestion).

Alex — can you confirm you'll review & sign the DocuSign once it hits your inbox? I'll copy the DocuSign link here when it's created.

Action items:
- Connor: map AS-300-B to the third line, attach corrected XLS.
- Laura: pre-approve spend cap jump to $50,000 and mark PROC-934 for accounting pickup.
- Ben: file the issuance root-cause and assign follow-up to platform for the autosave race.

Thanks all — aiming to close this before Aurora ships.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
related link: https://app.docusign.com/aurora/po/67891

From: Alex Mendez <alex.mendez@aurorasupply.com>

Cc: procurement@aurorasupply.com
Date: 2026-12-12T09:45:12-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Supply onboarding: provisional PO number mismatch — signed and confirmed

Mina / team — signed and returned. Attached is the executed DocuSign PDF and our copy of the corrected line-item spreadsheet. We were able to confirm the mapping for AS-300-B and scheduling is now green for the pilot shipment on 12/14.

Please pass this to your AP team for reconciliation; we expect payment terms to follow the contract. Thanks for the fast turnaround — appreciate the coordination.

Best,
Alex
Alex Mendez
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Supply
